headline: Dhaka tops remittances, six Chattogram districts in top ten
summary: Dhaka retained the top position for migrant worker remittances in July to September, the first three months of the fiscal year. Six Chattogram districts ranked in the top ten remittance-earning districts.
why: Remittances are a major source of foreign currency and household income in Bangladesh. They affect the country's external balance and reserves.
